messages:
olivia: quick profiler dump — seeing big prefill footprint spikes on long chat flows w/ batching=auto, posting a tiny summary + numbers. probs look like KV entries not reclaimed due to liveness mis-estimate, cc @sam @jia

```
profiler top allocs:
  kv_cache.prefill: 1.8GB
  workspace.buffers: 900MB
  decode.buffers: 600MB
  active_threads: 18
```

sam: nice, which kernel set was this using? kernel swap last week changed workspace packing sizes right?

olivia: kernels v2.4 (attn-optimized) + microbatch=4. hypothesis: kernel swap changed alignment/padding -> more slab fragmentation, so prefill can't reuse holes.

jia: that fragmentation pattern would leave holes that block new KV slabs. did you try coalesce-on-evict or thin-slab demote heuristics?

olivia: ran a couple micro-profiles: coalesce-on-evict reduced tail OOMs but increased per-token latency ~2-4ms. quick bench: coalesce -> -700MB resident vs baseline, p95 latency +3ms.

mike: what about per-request soft caps? limit prefill bytes per request and fall back to on-demand decode when cap exceeded. reduces worst-case footprint a lot.

olivia: exactly what I prototyped. soft_cap=256KB per-request + size-aware demote + LRU eviction. also adjusted batching heuristic to prefer shorter prefixes so we don't cross caps as a batch.

jia: also consider liveness sampling at encode-time: mark entries as cold if not accessed in last 30s and bias them for demotion/coalesce. avoids touching hot entries and reduces fragmentation churn.

olivia: perf tradeoff notes: demote-on-prefill + soft-cap -> 15% fewer OOMs in a 2h soak, median latency +3ms, but long-context flows see p95 regressions. need to balance tail vs OOMs.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: candidate rollout 'kv-softcap-v1' created, canary=5% us-west2.

sam: we should gate on kernel_workspace_choice: when runtime picks large-workspace kernel, enforce stricter cap. metric: workspace_util_ratio per kernel (ws_used / ws_alloc).

mike: agree. propose rule: if kernel_workspace_ratio > 0.7 then soft_cap=128KB else 256KB. also adapt batching: cap batch size when many long prefixes in queue to avoid aggregated prefill spike.

olivia: plan -> 6h canary w/ kernel-metric tag, collect p50/p95/p99 latency, OOM count, memory high-water. i'll wire dashboards and post results.

jia: add a synthetic microbench that mixes short and long chat flows to catch regressions early (mix ratios: 80% short/20% long). gate rollout on OOM <= baseline and tail latency within delta.

olivia: uploading microbench gist: https://gist.github.com/placeholder-microbench (will update with numbers)

sam: sg, also add a runtime flag for aggressive_coalesce so we can toggle if tail issues worsen.

olivia: :thumbsup: opening PR w/ soft-cap + kernel gating and bench results, will link here when ready.
